summary: Modularize performance validator and harden schema parity and symlink safety

delivery.outcome: Decompose src/performance.py into focused <500-line modules, eliminate unhashable TypeError crashes, enforce JSON Schema v1 parity in validate_plan, and harden symlink and fsync safety.
nonGoals: No breaking CLI or wire schema changes

architecture.decision: Split plan validation into src/performance_plan.py and static AST/Rust analyzers into src/performance_ast.py while keeping src/performance.py as the backward-compatible CLI and API facade.
architecture.rollback: Revert modularization and hardening commits on src/ and tests/.

validation.evidence: All unit tests, ruff checks, governance-check.sh, and wellman check pass with 0 errors.
